findings.title: C1 診断の実装方針が未明示
findings.rationale: C1「ID 文法適合」の check 診断は ParseResult.diagnostics（parse-time 診断、{severity, file, line, message} 形式）と同じ情報を持つ。check module が parse 診断を re-wrap して <LEVEL> <CODE> <id> <message> 形式で出力するのか、独立検証するのかが明示されていない。実装で迷う可能性があるが、どちらも機能的に成立するため blocking ではない。

observations.title: mod-graph / mod-check の設計宣言と要件が完全一致
observations.rationale: mod-graph と mod-check は design/static/modules.md に宣言済みであり、design/static/dependencies.md の許可依存 mod-check→mod-graph→mod-parse とも整合する。

observations.title: C11 の暫定実装は domain 方向のみだが要件は仕様全体を対象とする
observations.rationale: tools/check.sh は C11 の domain→非 domain のみを検査する。本実装は spec/format.md §10 を正本として static/dynamic 方向も対象とする必要があるが、現在の design/ は単一層内参照のみのため「design/ 評価ゼロ違反」の受け入れ基準は成立する。要件が spec/format.md §10 を正本参照しているため問題なし。

findings.title: C2 raw elements access gap — Graph.elements (Map) loses duplicates before checkC2 can see them
findings.rationale: Graph.elements is defined as Map<string, Element> (ElementTable). When buildGraph constructs this Map from parsed.elements, any duplicate IDs are silently overwritten. runCheck(graph, manifest, stateKeys?) has no parameter to receive the raw Element[] array, so checker.ts cannot pass the original duplicate-containing array to checkC2(graph, elements: Element[]). C2 (ID uniqueness) cannot be implemented as designed without access to the raw elements.

findings.title: C1 validateId dependency path violates allowed dependency graph
findings.rationale: T-06 says 'call validateId' but validateId lives in src/parse/id.ts. Per design/static/dependencies.md, mod-check → mod-parse is NOT an allowed edge (only mod-check → mod-graph is permitted). The design and tasks do not specify whether to re-export validateId through src/graph/, or to reimplement the ID grammar check inline in c01-id-grammar.ts. Without resolution, the implementor either violates the dependency design or duplicates logic without spec guidance.

findings.title: VIEW_TYPE_NAMES → prefix mapping unspecified — getEnabledPrefixes cannot convert view type names to prefixes
findings.rationale: LAYER_MAP is defined as prefix → layer (e.g. uc → views), but manifest.enabled uses human-readable type names like 'use-case', not prefixes. No mapping from enabled name to prefix exists anywhere in design.md or tasks.md. As a result, getEnabledPrefixes (T-05) cannot determine which prefixes to include when a view type is enabled, leaving C3 and C11 enabledPrefixes computation undefined for view types.

findings.title: D4 generic rule signature (graph, manifest) is inaccurate for at least 5 rules
findings.rationale: D4 states the universal rule signature as (graph: Graph, manifest: Manifest) => CheckDiagnostic[], but C2 requires Element[], C6 and C7 take only Manifest, C8 requires stateKeys: string[], and C3 and C11 require enabledPrefixes: Set<string>. The incorrect generic signature is the documentation root-cause that obscures the raw-elements gap in Finding #1.

findings.title: D2 states Graph bundles 'manifest' but T-02 specifies only manifestPath: string | null
findings.rationale: D2 describes Graph as bundling manifest as a top-level field alongside ElementTable, ReferenceIndex, etc. T-02's actual Graph type has manifestPath: string | null, not the parsed Manifest object. This inconsistency is misleading for implementors who read the design before the tasks.

findings.title: C3 source-layer filtering behavior for disabled-layer elements is undefined
findings.rationale: D6 specifies C3 skips references whose target prefix belongs to a disabled layer, but does not address references FROM disabled-layer source elements. For example with enabled: static, a seq-foo element (dynamic, disabled) referencing non-existent mod-nonexistent (static prefix, enabled) would produce a spurious C3 diagnostic, contradicting the 'disabled type obligations are not evaluated' principle. The degradation test (T-19) does not cover this case.

message: spec-review iteration 1 completed with verdict: escalation

findings.title: spec.md の「parsed manifest」記述が Graph 型定義と齟齬
findings.rationale: spec.md §1 の要件文「The graph module SHALL produce a Graph containing ... and parsed manifest」は Graph が解析済み Manifest オブジェクトを保持するように読める。しかし design.md D2 と tasks.md T-02 は Graph に manifestPath: string | null のみを含め、Manifest オブジェクトは含まないことを明示している。実装者が spec.md を先に読むと誤解する可能性がある。

findings.title: buildGraph シグネチャの manifestPath が string 必須だが Graph.manifestPath は string | null
findings.rationale: T-03 は buildGraph(parsed: ParseResult, manifestPath: string): Graph と定義し manifestPath を必須 string とするが、T-02 の Graph 型は manifestPath: string | null と宣言している。manifest.md が存在しない最小 fixture を扱う際に型の不整合が生じる可能性がある。実装上の workaround は容易。

observations.title: attempt 1 の 6 件の所見はすべて attempt 2 の design.md / tasks.md で解消済み
observations.rationale: HIGH: rawElements 追加（D2/T-02/T-07）、validateId re-export 経路明示（D2/T-02/T-06）。MEDIUM: VIEW_ENABLED_NAME_TO_PREFIX 全列挙（D3/T-05）、D4 の共通シグネチャ記述を実態に合わせ修正。LOW: Graph の manifest 記述修正（D2）、C3 参照元無効化の明示（D6/T-08/T-19）。

message: spec-review iteration 1 completed with verdict: approved
